headline: Jensen Huang Expresses Willingness to Return as Nvidia CEO Following Resignation
summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated he would return if asked, following his resignation last week. Corporate-governance experts noted potential difficulties with a return.
why: Nvidia Corporation is a major US technology company that designs graphics processing units and microchips for artificial intelligence applications.

impacts.name: Nvidia Corporation
impacts.why: Uncertainty surrounding executive leadership directly impacts company governance and investor sentiment.
